ti.title: እግዚአብሔር ጓሳይና’ዩ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
እግዚአብሔር ጓሳይና’ዩ ዝጎድለና የለን
ንጸላእቲ ስዒሩልና’ዩ የሕሊፉ ኣይሃበናን
ንሕይወትና በረኸት ጸጋ ዝዓደለና
ኣማኑኤል ይኽበር ይመስገን ዝሓለወና
[[/chorus]]

ጸላኤ ሰናያት እንክዋግኣኒ
ሰይፊ ኲናት ጌሩ ክቖራርጸኒ
ስቕ ኢልካ ኣይርኣኻን ኣደንጊጸካ’የ
ንኽብሪ በቒዐ በኣኻ ኣቦየ

ብሓሶት ብዝሙት ብስርቂ ብሓሜት
በቲ ረቂቕ ሜላ ብመናፍቕነት
ዓለም ተታሒዛ ምርኮ ሰይጣን ኮይና
ተለመና ጐይታይ ክትርኢ ምድኃና

ti_ro.title: 'Gziabher gwasayna’yu
ti_ro.lyrics:
Gziabher gwasayna’yu zgodlena yelen
Ntselati sirulna’yu yehlifu ayhabenan
Nhywetna berekhet tsega zadelena
Amanuel ykhber ymesgen zhalewena
Tselae senayat nkwagani
Seyfi kunat geru kqorartseni
Sq ilka ayrakhan adengitseka’ye
Nkhbri beqia beakha aboye
Nho ygwazm kem ambesa shden
Hji’wn ntekhone seytan ayarefen
Bzrguh qltsmka lomi wn tegelets
Bmesqel ktehaz bsmka kgsets
Bhasot bzmut bsrqi bhamet
Beti reqiq mela bmenafqnet
Alem tetahiza mrko seytan koyna
Telemena goytay ktri mdhana
Nay mdhan mkhnyat megedi aloka
Bkidan qdusan bdngl adekha
Ab bzuh shumena bwhud aminka (2)
